ammonia.reason: Modest amino-acid deamination by NSLAB during dry aging with low moisture limiting diffusion.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol, indole and 3-methylbutanoic acid from raw-milk microbiota and branched-chain amino acid breakdown.

bitter.reason: Accumulation of hydrophobic bitter peptides from chymosin and LAB peptidases accentuated by 4%+ salt.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation and no blue veining in closed pressed paste.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual amino acids and trace lactose/galactose on dry surface when heated.

buttery.reason: Residual diacetyl/acetoin from Lactococcus citrate metabolism largely lost during 3-month dry aging.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Extensive lipolysis by raw-milk lipases and LAB esterases releases butanoic/hexanoic acids.

creaminess.reason: Low 24% fat and low 37% moisture inhibit fat coalescence and oral lubrication.

crumbliness.reason: High salt, low pH and extensive proteolysis shorten casein network causing fracture.

firmness.reason: Low moisture, heavy pressing and 3-month drying creates dense cross-linked paracasein matrix.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism by wild lactobacilli.

fruity.reason: Limited ethyl butanoate/hexanoate esterification by LAB esterases in low-aw salty matrix.

goaty.reason: Free C6:0-C8:0 caproic/caprylic acids from milk-fat lipolysis without goat-specific branched acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker aldehydes 2-/3-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine catabolism during ripening.

melt.reason: Low moisture, high NaCl and demineralized aged casein prevent flow; softens only on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation, no surface mold contribution.

oil_off.reason: Low 24% fat entrapped in dry firm matrix limits free oil release despite heating.

smoky.reason: No smoke exposure; unsmoked curd with no guaiacol/syringol deposition.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic and acetic acids from mesophilic LAB lactose fermentation to pH ~5.2.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading and no aligned paracasein fibers for extension.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Uncooked rennet curd limits whey-protein denaturation and methionine-derived sulfides.

sweet.reason: Near-complete lactose depletion to lactic acid leaves no residual lactose sweetness.

umami.reason: High free glutamate and savory peptides from rennet plus plasmin proteolysis over months.
